ext_description.message: Scans the PSA and CGC slab photos on a page and opens the official cert page. Reads on-device. Not affiliated with PSA or CGC.
ext_description.description: Web Store / chrome://extensions description, max 132 characters.

action_title.message: Scan this page for slab cert numbers
action_title.description: Toolbar button tooltip (manifest default_title). The icon scans the page by default (A9).

context_menu_scan.description: Context menu item on images; also fills $MENU$.

locale_code.description: Not visible. Sets <html lang> and the Intl locale.

a11y_new_tab.description: Visually hidden suffix on buttons that open a tab.

idle_body.message: Right-click a slab photo on a web page and choose “$MENU$”.
idle_body.description: MENU is the context menu title.

idle_body_alt.message: Or drop, paste or upload an image below, or type the number.

drop_formats.message: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to $SIZE$

url_preview_pending.message: Choose a grader to see the link.

err_chars.message: Use digits, optionally after PSA or CGC.

err_length.message: Cert numbers have $MIN$ to $MAX$ digits. This one has $COUNT$.

err_grader.message: Choose PSA, CGC Comics or CGC Cards.

err_link.message: That link isn't a PSA or CGC cert page.

warn_length.message: Unusual length for $GRADER$. Check the number before opening.

scan_slow.message: Still working. Large images take longer.

result_bg_note.message: The page is in a background tab.

copy_done.description: Button label for 2 s after copying.

copy_failed.message: Couldn't copy. Select the number and copy it yourself.

verify_note.message: Check that the cert page matches this slab. A valid number alone doesn't prove the slab is genuine.

offline_note.message: You're offline. The page will load when you reconnect.

err_open_tab.message: Couldn't open a new tab. Try again.

reason_multiple.message: Found $COUNT$ possible numbers. Pick the one on the label.

reason_cgc_both.message: This number fits both CGC Comics and CGC Cards. Choose one.

reason_grader_unknown.message: Couldn't tell which grader this is. Choose one.

reason_unclear.message: The photo is small or unclear. Compare the number with the label.

reason_always_ask.message: You've set CertScanner to always ask before opening.

qr_offsite_title.message: QR code links to another site

qr_offsite_body.message: It points to $HOST$, not PSA or CGC, so it wasn't opened.
qr_offsite_body.description: Host as plain text, never a link.

qr_offsite_number.message: Only the number in it was used.

none_body.message: Try a sharper or closer photo of the label, or type the number.

err_restricted_heading.message: Chrome doesn't allow reading this page

err_restricted_body.message: Save or copy the image, then drop, paste or upload it here.

err_not_found_body.message: The page may have changed. Scroll the image into view and try again, or upload it.

err_too_large_body.message: Choose an image up to $SIZE$, or crop it to the label.

err_capture_body.message: Make sure the image is fully visible in the tab, then try again.

err_engine_body.message: Barcode scanning and typing the number still work. Reload the panel to try again.

err_file_type_body.message: Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF file.

err_decode_body.message: The file may be damaged. Try another image.

err_dropped_link_body.message: Links can't be scanned. Right-click the image on the page and choose “$MENU$”, or save it and drop the file.

err_generic_body.message: Try again, or type the number.

lowres_body.message: Images on this page come from $HOST$. Allow full-size images from that site for sharper scans.

lowres_fineprint.message: Chrome will ask you to allow access to $HOST$. CertScanner only uses it to load images you scan. Remove it any time in Settings.

perm_denied.message: No permission given. Scans on $HOST$ will use screen resolution.

perm_failed.message: Chrome couldn't show the permission request. Try again.

recent_off.message: History is off. You can turn it on in Settings.

recent_copy.description: Visually hidden label of the copy icon button.

setting_always_ask_hint.message: When off, the cert page opens by itself if exactly one number is read clearly.

setting_background_hint.message: Stay on the page you're viewing.

setting_history_hint.message: Saves the last $COUNT$ numbers on this device only. Turning this off deletes them.

settings_sites_heading.description: Settings section listing optional host grants (Sharper scans and Always allow).

settings_sites_body.message: You allowed these through “Sharper scans” or “Always allow”. CertScanner may load full-size images there and scan those pages from this panel.

settings_sites_empty.message: None yet. CertScanner offers this when a scan could be sharper or when it can't read a page.

about_privacy.message: Images are processed on this device and never uploaded. A cert number only leaves your device when the grader's page opens.

about_lookup.message: A cert lookup shows what the grader's database says about a number. It can't tell whether the slab in a photo is genuine.

about_disclaimer.message: Not affiliated with PSA or CGC.

about_trademarks.message: PSA and CGC are trademarks of their respective owners.

about_uninstall.message: Removing the extension deletes its scan history.

privacy_link.description: Link target is a release dependency.

ocr_unavailable_note.message: The text reader didn't start, so only the barcode was used.
ocr_unavailable_note.description: Added in S6: barcode result while OCR failed.

settings_sites_all.description: Added in S6 (SEC-11): row shown when access to all https sites is granted.

command_scan_page.message: Scan this page for slab cert numbers

page_scan_lead.message: Finds the slab photos on the page you're viewing and reads their cert numbers.

right_click_hint.message: Or right-click a slab photo and choose “$MENU$”.
right_click_hint.description: MENU is the context menu title.

shortcut_hint.message: Shortcut: $KEYS$, or click the CertScanner icon.
shortcut_hint.description: KEYS is the keyboard shortcut set in Chrome.

shortcut_none.message: Click the CertScanner icon to scan the page you're viewing.
shortcut_none.description: Shown when no keyboard shortcut is set.

page_finding.message: Looking for slab photos on this page…

page_results_summary.message: Found: $COUNT$. Open the one that matches the slab you're looking at.

page_result_photo.description: Thumbnail alt text in the results list.

page_none_heading.message: No cert numbers found on this page

page_none_no_images.message: No photos large enough to be a slab are visible on this page.

page_none_checked.message: Checked the photos on this page but couldn't read a cert number.

page_tip_open_photo.message: Small thumbnails are hard to read. Open the large photo of the listing, then scan again.

page_tip_right_click.message: Right-click a specific slab photo and choose “$MENU$”. If it was read at screen resolution, CertScanner offers sharper scans.

page_tip_upload.message: Or save the photo and upload or paste it below.

page_access_heading.message: CertScanner can't read this page yet

page_access_body_keys.message: Click the CertScanner icon in the toolbar, or press $KEYS$, to scan this page.

page_access_body.message: Click the CertScanner icon in the toolbar to scan this page.

page_access_fineprint.message: Chrome will ask you to allow access to $HOST$. CertScanner only uses it to find and read slab photos you scan. Remove it any time in Settings.

setting_scan_on_click_hint.message: When off, clicking the CertScanner icon only opens this panel.

action_title_open.description: Toolbar tooltip set at runtime when “Toolbar button scans the page” is off.

setting_shortcut_current.description: KEYS is the shortcut Chrome reports for “scan this page”.

setting_shortcut_hint.message: You can change it at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

setting_shortcut_button.description: Opens chrome://extensions/shortcuts in a new tab.

shortcut_hint_keys_only.description: Shown when the toolbar button only opens the panel.

page_access_body_none.message: Turn on “Toolbar button scans the page” in Settings, or set a keyboard shortcut, then use it on this page.

page_access_why.message: Chrome lets CertScanner read a page only after you use it on that page.

page_access_granted.message: Access allowed on $HOST$. Scanning this page.

page_results_partial.message: Stopped after 30 seconds: checked $CHECKED$ of $TOTAL$ photos.
page_results_partial.description: The page budget ran out; TOTAL is at least 2.

page_result_opened.description: Marks a results row whose cert page was opened.

err_page_timeout_heading.message: Scanning this page took too long

err_page_timeout_body.message: Try again, or right-click a specific slab photo and choose “$MENU$”.

err_restricted_page_body.message: Switch to a page in another tab and scan it, or save a slab photo and drop, paste or upload it here.
err_restricted_page_body.description: E1 body when a page scan (A9) hit a page Chrome does not let extensions read.

page_row_offsite.message: Taken from the QR code that links to $HOST$. Compare the number with the label.
page_row_offsite.description: Note under a page-results row whose number came from an off-site QR code (N2).

page_row_unclear.message: Not a clear read. Compare the number with the label.
page_row_unclear.description: Note under a page-results row read below the auto-open confidence.
